selection_basis: Coverage and family/behavior/cost diversity after raw audit. Pool frozen before training; descriptive full-subset means are not used to select best-single.
statistics_scope: Selected source splits before complete-case filtering. mean_score preserves raw benchmark scores, including request failures scored zero upstream; mean_success averages available success labels; mean_cost averages only positive observed costs (unavailable costs excluded). coverage requires valid label, cost and tokens.
